reason: The semiconductor sense needs the domain-specific fundición de semiconductores and must be distinguished from an ordinary metal foundry.
Microprocesador is a transparent, ubiquitous technical cognate with predictable gender and no narrower construction selected by the prompt.
Nanómetro is a transparent SI unit already familiar at this level; its accent and masculine gender add too little to justify a card.
The semiconductor context favours the precise fotolitografía rather than the broader artistic and printing term litografía.
Semiconductor die is pastilla semiconductora or chip sin encapsular; legacy matriz selects an unrelated mould or matrix sense.
Despite the awkward English nominalization, the fabless business model requires a production-ready expansion such as empresa de semiconductores sin fábrica.
Sistema en un chip teaches the required article, the established SoC abbreviation and the distinction between an integrated system and a microprocessor.
La ley de Moore is a familiar, compositionally transparent proper-name expression with no additional production difficulty in this prompt.
Circuito integrado is a transparent and ubiquitous electronics term with ordinary masculine gender and regular modification.
Redes neuronales is now familiar core AI vocabulary, directly cognate and morphologically predictable.
Aprendizaje profundo is the conventional nonliteral Spanish field name and merits contrast with both machine learning and the retained English label.
Aprendizaje automático is an established nonliteral term vulnerable to transfer from Portuguese aprendizagem de máquina and English machine learning.
Datos de entrenamiento fixes the machine-learning sense and supports a useful distinction from the narrower conjunto de entrenamiento.
Algoritmos is a transparent, ubiquitous computing cognate with predictable masculine plural morphology.
The full term teaches the established lenguaje natural collocation, lowercase styling and the Spanish abbreviation PLN rather than English NLP.
Redes generativas adversarias is a contested technical rendering with meaningful adjective-choice and cross-language word-order traps.
Aprendizaje por refuerzo is a fixed nonliteral construction whose preposition and noun cannot be inferred safely from English morphology.
Ética de la IA is a transparent and now familiar technology-policy compound, and the prompt selects no narrower ethical framework.
Aprendizaje supervisado is compositionally transparent, established core AI vocabulary with regular adjective agreement.
Aprendizaje no supervisado is compositionally transparent and differs from the familiar supervised term only by regular negation.
Modelo is a transparent, high-frequency cognate, while the isolated prompt gives no basis for choosing a specialized statistical or AI sense.
Logística is transparent, ubiquitous business vocabulary already well below C1 and carries no special construction here.
Inventario is a familiar direct business cognate, and the bare prompt does not isolate a useful contrast with existencias or stocktaking.
Procurement requires a context-sensitive choice among aprovisionamiento, gestión de compras and public-sector contratación, which the legacy gloss does not expose.
The logistics method needs a domain head noun and the JIT abbreviation to distinguish it from the everyday phrase justo a tiempo.
Distribución is a transparent, familiar logistics cognate with regular morphology and no narrower channel or process specified.
Logística de terceros is a specialist service model with the established abbreviation 3PL and a genuine third party versus tercer partido trap.
The nonliteral plazo de entrega blocks a liderazgo calque and must be varied when the measured process is manufacturing or replenishment.
Sourcing specifically foregrounds finding and selecting suppliers, so legacy aprovisionamiento wrongly collapses it into the broader procurement process.
Spain-oriented retail usage prefers referencia interna or número de referencia, and an SKU must be distinguished from universal EAN and GTIN identifiers.
Previsión de la demanda is a productive logistics collocation with a real previsión/provisión and Portuguese-spelling interference risk.
Efecto látigo is a fixed specialist metaphor, without de, for the amplification of order variability along a supply chain.
Integración vertical is a compositionally transparent and familiar business-policy term with ordinary gender and adjective agreement.
Externalización is the Spain-oriented term and supports a useful distinction from subcontratación and Latin American tercerización.
Transporte is familiar core vocabulary with a direct translation and no selected modal, legal or logistics-specific sense.
Gestión de almacenes captures receipt, placement, picking and dispatch, materially improving on legacy almacenamiento when the broader operation is intended.
Nodo is a transparent, familiar technical cognate, and the prompt does not select a network, logistics, graph-theory or infrastructure sense.
Routine status tracking is idiomatically hacer el seguimiento de, with government worth teaching and a narrower sense than legacy rastrear.
Marginar is a transparent, familiar critical verb with regular conjugation and no special complement selected by the prompt.
Intransitive profit requires beneficiarse de or obtener beneficios de; legacy rentabilizar is transitive and reverses the argument structure.
